new
new
add v1 water 1mol
inspect
distil v1 v2 1e-14
inspect
expectation: A representable 1e-14 fraction transfers positive water overhead and positive latent heat, conserving source plus receiver.

script:
register lv3
new
new
add v1 water 4mol
add v1 ethanol 6mol
inspect
distil v1 v2 8kJ
inspect
expectation: An energy-limited ethanol/water cut spends 8kJ latent heat on positive, ethanol-enriched overhead; both component budgets remain conserved.
